Primary request: one calm rooster in left-facing side profile in a sunny farm orchard; natural small side eye looking down at the grass, closed beak, small red comb, warm red-brown body and curved green tail feathers, two legs and folded wings. Style: simplified rounded cartoon forms, gentle watercolor washes, warm cream paper, muted natural earthy colors and delicate soft botanical scenery. Clearly more cartoonish than realistic; no realistic wrinkles, skin pores, detailed fur, hairs or sharp facial features. One clear animal subject, large and easily recognizable, comfortably inside the frame. Keep natural animal anatomy, calm body language and eyes visibly directed sideways or down toward the environment. Every face stays in profile, never turned toward the viewer. No direct eye contact, human smiles, smile-shaped mouth curves, lips, eyebrows, lashes, visible teeth or fangs. No anthropomorphic face. The subject rests naturally in its own setting; every page has a distinct scene. Keep background soft and secondary. Let scenery fade gently into clean warm ivory paper around all edges and all four corners, with generous clear corners. No people, other animals, text, symbols, numerals, frame, border or watermark.
